INFINITY GRID COMPONENTS — STEP44 S0 PREREGISTRATION
NEXT-LAYER TYPED-CONSUMER / READINESS AUDIT
Date: 2026-09-20

STATUS BEFORE AUDIT
SOURCE-ONLY. NO DECODER SCIENCE RUN. NO NEW FORMATION LAW.

FROZEN INPUT
- D12 and M354-M356 are fixed.
- G8 exact state X=(I,(T_i),Omega) remains canonical.
- Step43 terminal classification remains:
  STEP43_CLOSED_TWO_TIER_CONDITIONAL_ALGEBRA_COMPLETE_PRIMITIVE_PROVENANCE_OPEN.
- The conditional object is BOUNDARY_ROOTED_EXACT_ROW_OVERLAP_NETWORK.
- Its authoritative working equality is complete UTF-8 bytes under
  IG_CANONICAL_EXACT_ROW_GRAPH_CODE_V1; SHA-256 is only an index.

QUESTION
Does the current source stack already contain a literal higher-layer consumer of
the Step43 conditional object, together with a type-correct adapter whose declared
observations and operations commute with the Step43 interface?

REQUIRED CONSUMER CONTRACT
A candidate must explicitly declare:
1. source carrier and target carrier;
2. observer/equality and SET/BAG semantics;
3. legal actions or formation operations;
4. which Step43 fields it reads;
5. a literal adapter from the Step43 carrier;
6. preservation/commutation obligations for identity and composition;
7. whether projection forgets exact rows or witnesses;
8. exact scope and stopping rule.

ACCEPTANCE GATE
A next layer is ready only if one current source-bound candidate has:
- a declared target type;
- a literal adapter from the Step43 type;
- no invented primitive provenance;
- no unsafe projection of exact rows/incidence/witnesses;
- a coherent operation/observer commutation obligation that can be tested.

PREDECLARED OUTCOMES
A. NEXT_LAYER_TYPED_CONSUMER_READY
   At least one candidate passes every gate; freeze its S0 base and proceed.
B. NO_CURRENT_TYPED_NEXT_LAYER_CONSUMER_COMPONENTS_PARKED_AT_STEP43
   No candidate declares the required target/adapter contract; close Step44 S0
   without computation and park Components until a new consumer is proposed.
C. CANDIDATE_REJECTED_UNSAFE_OR_UNTYPED
   A proposed route exists but requires invented fields, analogy-only translation,
   premature support projection, or a type/semantics mismatch.

SOURCE DISCIPLINE
- Current v21.0/Step43 sources have authority.
- Older G9 documents may be inspected only to determine whether they literally
  consume the new carrier. Their names do not make them the successor of the
  current post-node G8 stack.
- Old theory/concept documents are analogy-only and cannot satisfy admission.
- A general connected-graph Lean proof is proof strengthening, not a higher-layer
  scientific consumer.

STOPPING RULE
Stop immediately when the current stack is exhausted. Do not invent G9, fit an
adapter, project to support merely to obtain a match, or run a graph census.

NONCLAIMS
No geometry, metric, dimension, probability, time, causality, spacetime, actual
network, selection law, global minimality, primitive provenance or full G8 grammar
closure may be inferred from this audit.

NEXT-LAYER TYPED-CONSUMER / READINESS CLOSEOUT

STATUS
CLOSED / SOURCE-ONLY / NO COMPUTATION REQUIRED

OUTCOME
NO_CURRENT_TYPED_NEXT_LAYER_CONSUMER_COMPONENTS_PARKED_AT_STEP43

BOTTOM LINE
The Step43 conditional algebra is ready to be consumed, but the current source
stack does not yet define a higher scientific layer that consumes it.

This is not a failure of Step43. It is the correct readiness boundary: we have a
well-typed conditional object and algebra, but no independently motivated target
carrier, observer, action set or literal adapter for a successor layer.

WHAT WAS FROZEN
- D12 and M354-M356.
- Exact G8 state X=(I,(T_i),Omega).
- BOUNDARY_ROOTED_EXACT_ROW_OVERLAP_NETWORK.
- IG_CANONICAL_EXACT_ROW_GRAPH_CODE_V1, with complete bytes as equality.
- Step43's conditional/provenance split and all pre-geometric guardrails.

WHAT WAS AUDITED
1. Historical G9 continuation/context-action work.
2. G8 RQ continuation.
3. Projection to ordinary support.
4. Actual-network/geometry/dimension routes.
5. General connected-graph Lean formalization.
6. An otherwise unspecified future G9 or higher layer.

KEY FINDING ABOUT HISTORICAL G9
The August G9 documents are real algebraic work, but they are not the next layer
after the current post-node G8. They consume primitive exact relations T_X and
rooted context actions. They predate the present G7/G8 carrier stack and define no
map from a boundary-rooted exact-row overlap network into their domain.

Therefore the common name “G9” is historical nomenclature, not a type connection.
Promoting it as the successor of current G8 would be a category error unless a new
adapter and target contract are independently defined.

OTHER CANDIDATES
- G8 RQ is same-layer observer-relative minimization, not a new layer.
- Support projection is guarded. It is unsafe before a declared target observer
  proves that exact edge rows and witness values will never be read.
- A general graph Lean proof would strengthen D12/M354-M355, but it would not
  create a higher carrier or solve primitive provenance.
- Actual network, selection, geometry, metric, dimension and physics remain
  blocked because no carrier/observer/selector has been earned.

SCIENTIFIC DECISION
Do not invent a G9 experiment. Do not run Decoder. Do not fit an adapter. Do not
project away exact information merely to match an older lane.

Components is parked cleanly at Step43 until a new higher-layer question supplies:
1. a target carrier;
2. observer/equality and SET/BAG semantics;
3. legal actions/formation operations;
4. a literal adapter from the Step43 carrier;
5. identity/composition/projection proof obligations;
6. a fail-closed preregistration.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PROJECT
The next useful work is the separate general connected-graph formalization. It can
upgrade the conditional theorem's proof status without pretending to discover a
new layer. After that, the programme should pause until a genuinely motivated
higher-layer observable is proposed.

LEDGER CONSEQUENCE
No new mechanism ID is earned. Step44 S0 is a programme/readiness decision, not a
new scientific mechanism.

NONCLAIMS
No universal impossibility theorem for future layers; no primitive provenance;
no full G8 grammar closure; no global minimality; no actual network, geometry,
metric, dimension, probability, time, causality, spacetime or physical meaning.
